basic_details.job_title: MRVC Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation (MRVC) has published the Assistant Manager Notification 2026 on its official website, https://mrvc.indianrailways.gov.in. The recruitment drive aims to fill 1 Assistant Manager position on a contractual basis. Candidates not exceeding 35 years of age and holding a B.E./B.Tech. in Civil Engineering with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA along with an M.Tech./M.E. in Structural Engineering or an equivalent postgraduate qualification are eligible to apply. The application process is being conducted through email and will remain active up to 30-08-2026. Ca

qualification.details: Assistant Manager : B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA and Post Graduation in Structural Design (M. Tech or ME (Structure)) / (Structural Engineering)/Civil with Structural Engineering subject. Experience: Minimum 2 years of working experience of structural design in IDA E1/E2 grade or equivalent. Total Experience: Should have minimum 6 years of overall working experience in Government/Railway PSU on regular/contract basis. Should have in-depth understanding of structure designs such as bridges, multi-story buildings. knowledge of Indian Railway codes and Manuals. knowledge of tools like AutoCAD, Revit MEP, Software, MIDAS, STAAD, SAP, E-tab to create precise system designs and models. Candidates having work experience in suburban section will have added advantages.

salary_details.details: IDA Equivalent E-2 grade Rs.50,000-1,60,000 Basic Pay Rs.50,000/- per month Pay and perks include Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance, Cafeteria of Allowances, House Rent Allowance, Consolidated Travelling Allowance, Provident Fund (employer's share) etc. Other entitlements like mobile phone, laptop, Sodexo etc are as per the policy of the corporation. Pay protection will be given to candidates working in IDA E2 grade in Railway/Railway PSUs.

selection_process: Preliminary screening of applications Document verification and interaction Interview by a nominated Committee Final selection on merit based on performance in the interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MRVC Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MRVC Assistant Manager (Design) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 30th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Assistant Manager (Design) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering with at least 60% marks and a Post Graduation in Structural Design (M. Tech or ME (Structure)) / (Structural Engineering)/Civil with Structural Engineering subject.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Manager (Design) position is 35 years as of the notification issue date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Manager (Design) role?
faq.answer: The salary is IDA Equivalent E-2 grade, ranging from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000, with a basic pay of Rs. 50,000 per month. Other allowances and perks are also provided.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the MRVC Assistant Manager (Design) position?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent via email to [email protected]. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line is correctly filled.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification released by MRVC for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Manager (Design) post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves preliminary screening, document verification and interaction, and a final interview by a nominated committee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Assistant Manager (Design) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Does MRVC offer any pay protection for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, pay protection will be provided to candidates who are currently working in IDA E2 grade in Railway or Railway PSUs.

faq.question: Q10. What kind of experience is required for this position?
faq.answer: A minimum of 2 years of structural design experience in IDA E1/E2 grade or equivalent, and a total of 6 years of overall working experience in Government/Railway PSU is required.
